turns.text: Hey Lloyd, do you remember that paper I mentioned last week? Mind the Memory Gap. I think Recasens et al. published it in 2025.
Yes, I have that noted. Is there something specific you want to do with it?
Just checking. Also, my coffee maker is acting up again. The steam wand leaks unless I hold it at a weird angle.
That sounds like a gasket issue. Have you tried tightening the connection?
I did, no luck. I'll probably just buy a new one from Amazon later. Anyway, back to the paper, it's been pretty useful for my research.
Glad to hear it. Let me know if you need help summarizing other sections.
Lloyd, I finally ran those benchmarks. Mind the Memory Gap really unveils GPU bottlenecks in large-batch LLM inference. That was the key takeaway for me.
Interesting. Did those bottlenecks match the theoretical predictions from the paper?
Pretty much. It was annoying to debug though. Also, did you hear the weather forecast for Saturday? They say rain all day.
Yes, I saw that. Might be a good day to stay in and code.
Exactly my plan. I need to finish the report on this inference issue. The data is solid, though.
Great. Let me know if you need any assistance formatting the results.
Maybe later. I'm going to grab lunch.
